data.name: Code symbol
data.description: Functions, methods and classes defined in the analysed files.

related_terms.name: Call site
related_terms.description: Call edges inside functions, methods and class bodies, with how the callee was resolved. Direct call sites are all kept; those without an internal callee have a null callee and are classified as builtin, external, dynamic_attribute or unresolved. Callback rows record an internal function or method passed by reference as an argument to another call, e.g. asyncio.to_thread(f, x).

related_terms.name: Class base
related_terms.description: Base classes named in each class statement, in order, with the internal class each one resolves to.

related_terms.name: Source file
related_terms.description: One row per analysed Python source file.
